questions.title: Tell me about a time you shared bad news early instead of waiting until it was unavoidable.
Describe a time you gave a teammate honest feedback that was hard to hear.
Tell me about a decision you disagreed with. How did you say so, and what happened next?
Describe a time you made information visible to people outside your team so they could decide better.
Tell me about a mistake you made at work or in a project and how you told others about it.
Tell me about a time you had to balance shipping quickly against building something well.
Describe a project you cared about deeply. What did you do that nobody asked you to?
Tell me about a time you pushed back on scope to protect quality or the team's workload.
Describe a trade-off you made where the right answer was not obvious. How did you decide?
Tell me about a time you changed your plan because of what a user or customer told you.
Describe a time you found a problem that would have hurt users and what you did about it.
Tell me about a time the easiest technical choice was not the best one for the user.
Describe how you have measured whether something you built actually helped the people using it.
Tell me about a time you helped a teammate succeed at the cost of your own task.
Describe a conflict within a team you were part of and how it was resolved.
Tell me about a time you worked with people whose working style was very different from yours.
Describe a time a team you were on failed to deliver. What was your part in it?
Tell me about a process or tool you improved without being asked.
Describe a time you noticed something broken that wasn't your job to fix. What did you do?
Tell me about a time you convinced others to try a new way of working.
Describe something you learned on your own because a project needed it.
